title: BARCELONA WANT €55M FOR THE FORMER CAPTAIN THEY COULD NOT FIND MINUTES FOR
description:
A loan, an option, and a defender with two goals in 15 games.

Deco says Barcelona would happily take 55 million euros from Liverpool for Ronald Araujo. He is a 27-year-old Uruguay defender, a former Barcelona captain, and he's on loan at Liverpool, who hold an option, not an obligation, to sign him for good.

He has two goals in 15 games for Liverpool. At Barcelona he struggled for minutes.

Before anyone writes the cheque: Deco says timing and fee could still be negotiated, so 55 million is a conversation, not a receipt. Araujo would need new personal terms too. The player gets a vote.

Deco also denies any plan to sell Alejandro Balde, who has played five matches.
